annotations.title: Rebuild your app as a free full-site preview

description: Starts the app's free full-site preview: up to 80 pages (all pages by default, or pages the owner picks) are rebuilt from the uploaded app file as React pages on sample data, then checked and scored automatically. Free, once per app. Nothing in the owner's app changes and nothing is charged. It takes a few minutes: call nc_preview_status to follow it. Asking again for the same job returns the build that is already running.

job_id.description: The job_id from nc_connect. The app file must already be uploaded and planned (nc_compile_plan).

pages.description: Names of up to 80 pages, as listed by nc_compile_plan with detail full. Leave out to compile all pages.
